tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du skye ba'i smon lam btab pa'i phan yon gyi lung sbyor bzhugs// ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ /dag pa'i zhing rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa bde ba can du skye bar rtse gcig tu smon lam btab pa'i phan yon ni/ sman bla'i mdo las/ bde ba can du skye bar smon lam 'debs pa de dag 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad rdzu 'phrul gyis lhags nas lam ston par 'gyur ro/ zhes dang / gtsug tor dri med kyi mdo las/ sbrul lpags pa brjes pa bzhin du lus 'di bor nas bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / bde ba can gyi zhing bkod las/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med de'i kha dog dang / dbyibs dang / chu zheng / zhabs 'bring pa dge slong gi dge 'dun ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa dag mdun du gnas par 'gyur te/ de dag de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bas rab tu dang ba la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin de dang / brjed pa med pa'i dran pas shi 'phos nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nyid du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs shing / gzhan yang mdo za ma tog bkod pa thos pas kyang bde ba can du skye bar bshad de/ ji skad du/ mdo de nyid las/ 'chi ba'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa bcu gnyis gshegs nas dbugs 'byin par mdzad de/ rigs kyi bu ma 'jigs shig khyod kyis theg pa chen po'i mdo sde rin po che'i rgyal po za ma tog bkod pa thos so/ /bde ba can du 'gro ba'i phyir lam sna tshogs kyang sta gon byas so/ /gdugs sna tshogs dang / cod pan dang / sna cha dang / se mo do rnams kyang sta gon byas la/ ltas de lta bu 'byung zhing 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe bar chad med par bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /yang rje gzhon nu rgyal mchog pa'i byang chub lam gyi sgron me'i don 'grel las 'di ltar 'byung ste/

rdzus nas skye ba'i rgyu dkon mchog sprin gyi mdo las bcu gsungs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa dang / mchod rten zhig pa 'chos pa dang / mchod rten la spos kyi byug pa 'bul ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dag la khrus kyi spos chu 'bul ba dang / mchod rten la phyag dar dang skyang nul bya ba 'bul ba dang / pha ma la lus kyis rim 'gro byed pa dang / mkhan po dang slob dpon la lus kyis rim gro byed pa dang / de'ang zang zing dang bcas pa'i sems kyis ma yin par/ zang zing med pa'i sems kyis byed pa dang / rgyu de rnams la brten nas sems can thams cad mngal gyi nyes pas ma gos par gyur cig ces bsngo zhing / de'ang bsam pa thag pa nas bsngo bar byed pa dang bcu'o/ /dang po ni/ rten bzhengs pa'i nus pa yod pa nyung / yo byad bsgrugs nas byas na chos dang mi 'gal ba med/ lha bzo ba khram pa dang 'thab nag byed byed nas chos la byi bcad byed nyen che bas na/ rang cag gi lag len du tsha tsha gdab/ mchod rten zhig pa'i 'og nas mi ma yin yong nyen che bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku la zhig pa med pa nyid du bsam/ mi ma yin med par bstan la phebs nas gso bar yang bya zhes gsung yang bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa gsal ba'i me long phun tshogs bco brgyad pa las/ gang gi mtshan thos dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams/ /bde ba can du skye ba'i rgyur bsngos na/ /mtshams med chos spong ma gtogs don grub pa/ /'phrin las phun tshogs zhing khams bde ba can/ /zhes kyang 'byung ba yin no/ /zhes pa'i lung btus nyung ngu 'di/ /'khon rigs sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /sbyar bas don kun 'grub gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ/ /de bzhin gshegs sku mchod rten ni/ /bzhengs dang nyams pa gso ba dang / /mchod rten de bzhin gshegs sku la/ /spos kyis byug dang spos chus bkru/

/mchod rten phyag dar skyang nul 'bul/ /pha ma dang ni mkhan slob la/ /lus kyis rim gro byed pa dang / /de kun zang zing med pa yi/ /kun slong gis bya dge ba rnams/ /'gro kun mngal gyis mi gos par/ /bsngo zhing de yang kha tsam gyis/ /min pa bsam pa dag pa yin/ /bsngo ba de rnams rdzus skyes su/ /skye ba'i zab mo'i thabs sam rgyu/ /bcur ni dkon mchog sprin nyid las/ /gsungs zhes dkon mchog 'bangs kyis gsungs/ /zhes pa'ang ngag dbang kun dgas smras/ /dharma u da ya mastu chos 'di dar bar gyur cig/ // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ bde ba can gyi zhing du skye ba'i smon lam btab pa'i phan yon gyi lung sbyor/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
